quests.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Cleanup

dialogue.t: Traveler, please wait. Here's a letter for you.
Yeah, Xudong left it for you. You know, the guy from Liyue.

dialogue.sit: Why did he leave a letter for me?

dialogue.t: Beats me. All I know is that he dropped by in a hurry the other day and left this letter.
He wanted me to make sure to give it to you. He even offered to pay.
Xudong came here... in a hurry? Something must've happened to him, huh.
Did that bad guy cause trouble again?

dialogue.sit: Why don't we read the letter first?
It might tell us what happened.

dialogue.t: Okay... Let's see what he wrote.

quests.description: Maryam from Gilded Journey appears to want a word with you…
